steps.title: The Initial Value Prop
steps.body: Hi [Name], I've noticed many CPAs are seeing clients struggle with high-interest line of credit renewals. We are currently helping firms secure 12-24 month terms at [Rate] to preserve their cash. Would you be open to a 5-minute call on how we can support your clients' growth?

steps.title: The 'Second Look' Follow-up
steps.body: Hi [Name], just checking back. If any of your clients were turned down by traditional banks recently, we often find a way to fund based on gross revenue rather than just net profit. Happy to review a set of redacted financials anytime.

steps.title: Bridge to Close
steps.body: Hi [Name], I saw your listing for [Business Type]. If your buyer is coming up short on the SBA injection, we can provide a subordinated bridge loan to get the deal across the finish line. Let's chat before the contingency period ends.
